body: GRETA GERWIG handing taylor a leadership award!! 🥹 THR just named her this year's Sherry Lansing honoree for its Women in Entertainment gala, and the names before her include Meryl Streep and Oprah. crying at my desk https://longlivets.com/?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=news

altText: Taylor Swift performing live "Love Story" in the American Leg on July.

critique.rationale: Same-day award news, confirmed by THR (the host) and Billboard: the award, Greta Gerwig presenting, and the namesake plus two past winners carry it. The Love Story balcony photo is a real credited Taylor photo, loosely tied to a leadership award.

why: Event news, intake #6814: THR announced 2026-11-11 that Taylor will receive its 2026 Sherry Lansing Leadership Award, presented by Greta Gerwig at the Women in Entertainment gala (THR + Billboard). 11-12 had neither platform filled, so no beat displaced. X half written first.
